references.text: The song they likely sang before leaving the place, which was part of the Passover celebration.
Reference to the event when Jesus came to the Mount of Olives, closely linked to the events in Matthew 26:30.
Mark's parallel account of the event, where they sing a hymn before going out to the Mount of Olives.
Luke's account that Jesus went to the Mount of Olives, following his last meal with the disciples.
John also mentions that Jesus crossed the Kidron Brook, where there is a garden, which may suggest movement toward the Mount of Olives after the meal.
